name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
summary: A maternity benefit scheme that provides a cash benefit of Rs. 5000 to pregnant and lactating mothers for their first living child, to partly compensate for wage loss and to promote health-seeking behaviour.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must be 19 years of age or older.
The applicant must be a woman.

entitlement_rules.text: An eligible mother receives a cash benefit of Rs. 5000 for the first living child.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First appeal at the block level.

appeal_hierarchy.authority: State Health and Family Welfare Authority
